title.zh: 量子弹弓双排扭力透镜

excerpt.zh: 量子弹弓的第二个扭力透镜装置已经就位，并同第一个装置进行了平衡。射程和准确度都提高了。
excerpt.en: A second arrangement of Quantum Catapult torsion lenses is now in position, diametrically balancing the first. Range and accuracy are increased.
